series.label: Annual freshwater withdrawals, total (billion cubic meters)

sources.title: World Bank WDI / FAO · ER.H2O.FWTL.K3
sources.date: 2022 API reference year; underlying observations can be older
sources.note: Indicator-specific metadata and observations retained in the October 27 source collection. Withdrawals are not necessarily consumptive use.

limitations: 2022 is a common WDI reference year; original national observations and estimation methods differ.
Withdrawals are water taken from a source, not necessarily water permanently consumed.
A high agricultural share does not alone establish waste or justify a particular allocation.
Out-of-range source percentages are retained in the research files and omitted from these mapped percentage views.
series.hosted_scope_note: All retained observations for this measure in the named built-in dataset. Native dates, reporting populations and unavailable/source-ineligible values remain unchanged.
